title: [scripts] Undefined function err_print() causes NameError in populate_file_web_server.py
author: rustiqly
body:
### Description

`scripts/populate_file_web_server.py` calls `err_print()` on lines 123 and 133, but this function is never defined. The rest of the file uses `print_msg()`.

### Current code (line 123)
```python
try:
    f = open(resource_path, 'rb')
except:
    err_print("Cannot open " + resource_path)   # NameError!
    return RET_CODE_CANNOT_OPEN_FILE
```

### Impact
When a file cannot be opened or an HTTP error occurs, `err_print()` throws `NameError`, masking the original error and preventing the correct return code.

### Fix
Replace `err_print(...)` with `print_msg(PRINT_LEVEL_ERROR, ...)`.

linkedPullRequests.author: rustiqly
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### What I did
Replace undefined `err_print()` with `print_msg(PRINT_LEVEL_ERROR, ...)` which is the function used throughout the rest of the file.

#### How I did it
Two instances on lines 123 and 133 replaced.

#### How to verify it
`grep -n err_print scripts/populate_file_web_server.py` returns no matches.

#### Which release branch to backport
master

#### Description for the changelog
Fix NameError caused by undefined err_print() function in populate_file_web_server.py.

Fixes: #26401
